reason: I cook at home to eat clean and keep oil, salt and sugar down, and nothing here talks about that. Basil pork with fried egg, pork omelet and pad see ew are the oily dishes I'm trying to get away from, so I might try the two free ones, but I already learn from free clips every night and wouldn't pay 99 a month.
objection: Nothing tells me the calories or how to make a dish lighter, so it feels like paying to learn the same oily street food I can watch for free on TikTok before bed. Good that most dishes need one pan, but that alone doesn't make me pay.
would_change_my_mind: A healthy version of every dish: calories per plate and the chef walking me through less oil, salt and sugar, still in my one pan.
